name: noxhere
description: Read Feedback, Planning and Delivery in one connected NoxHere project, with optional unresolved Incidents access.

interface.longDescription: Read-only access to your project through your own project-scoped automation token. Get a known Spot report, inspect Planning tasks, features, specifications and repository issues, and review Delivery and pull requests. An additional approved issues:read scope enables the latest 50 unresolved Incidents. Growth, Usage and Settings tools are not available in this release. Evidence is metadata and references only. No edits, downloads, credential management or external messages are exposed.
defaultPrompt: Summarize Planning in my NoxHere project.
Read this Spot report and explain the evidence.
Review recent Delivery and pull requests.
